subject: Coord: Calendaring -- procurement & security windowing for on-prem VPC architecture review
messages:
From: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.ai>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@acme.com>, Priya Shah <priya.shah@acme-med.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.ai>, procurement@acme.com
Date: Wed, 25 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Coord: Calendaring -- procurement & security windowing for on-prem VPC architecture review

Hi Liam / Priya / team,

Thanks again for the opportunity to dig into the on-prem VPC design. Per our previous call, the customer engineering and security stakeholders want a focused architecture deep-dive that covers networking, IAM, and the procurement checklist so approvals align with your deployment window.

To avoid multiple back-and-forths I put together a short agenda and two proposed blocks (each ~90 minutes):
- Option A: Tue Dec 7, 10:00–11:30 PT (engineering + security + procurement)
- Option B: Thu Dec 9, 13:00–14:30 PT (engineering + SE deep-dive then procurement closes)

Agenda (attached):
1) High-level deployment flow and model variants (15m)
2) Network & routing + jumpbox / VPN options (30m)
3) IAM & key-management (20m)
4) Procurement timeline, required artifacts, next steps (20m)

Who from your side should be present for the network and for procurement? If neither option fits, please share 3 windows next week and we will coordinate with Ben / Marissa / Sergio. I attached a short agenda and I can share a mutual action plan after we lock times.

Attachments: redwood-vpc-deepdive-agenda.pdf

Thanks,
Camila Reyes
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
camila.reyes@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0143
From: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@acme.com>

Date: Thu, 26 Nov 2026 09:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Coord: Calendaring -- procurement & security windowing for on-prem VPC architecture review

Camila — thanks for the clear options. Option A looks promising for our engineering leads.

Attendees from our side:
- Liam O'Connor (Platform Eng, will lead network discussion)
- Anita Gomez (InfoSec) — she'll join the security portion only
- Priya Shah (Procurement) — will need to confirm procurement windows but can join the tail end

A couple of asks before we lock:
- Can Redwood provide a SOC 2 summary and where we can find KMS/HSM details? Anita wants to triage before the session.
- For Option A, will you be able to share expected jumpbox / NAT egress IPs ahead of time for our firewall team?

If you can circulate the mutual action plan that includes procurement milestones we can 1) slot this in the calendar and 2) escalate within procurement.

— Liam
Liam O'Connor | Principal Platform Engineer, ACME Corporation

Liam — great, thanks. Camila and I talked through timing and procurement constraints on our side. A note on procurement: ACME's standard turnaround for PO review + security review historically takes ~10 business days once we provide the MAP (mutual action plan). If you need a faster path, we can surface an accelerated checklist during the session.

I attached a draft MAP that we typically iterate on; it includes the procurement checkpoints, required commercial docs, and a tentative timeline. Can you share the procurement lead's preferred invoicing/billing contact?

Attachment: RWD-ACME-mutual-action-plan.xlsx

If Option A works, Ben (me), Marissa (SE), and Sergio (infra SE) will be on the call. Camila will run the session.

Thanks,
Ben Carter

Subject: Re: Coord: Calendaring -- procurement & security windowing for on-prem VPC architecture review

Hi all — quick technical notes to prepare the deep-dive if we lock Option A (Tue Dec 7):
- Please confirm whether the target environment uses NAT egress via a corporate egress IP or direct peering; if possible, provide a sample list of firewall rules we should be aware of.
- We'll want a short 15-minute connectivity check the day prior (Mon Dec 6) to verify TLS handshakes and a test user with your IAM test role.
- If ACME requires an air-gapped option, flag that up front; we'll surface the on-prem artifacts we can share ahead of time.

Suggested SE attendees: Marissa Cole (solutions engineer), Sergio Alvarez (infra lead).

Best,
Marissa
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai
From: Anita Gomez <anita.gomez@acme.com>

Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 10:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Coord: Calendaring -- procurement & security windowing for on-prem VPC architecture review

Camila / Marissa — thanks. A couple of security items to triage before the architecture session:
- We need a copy of any recent SOC 2 Type II report or a compliance matrix showing which controls you map to (even a redacted copy).
- Encryption at rest — confirm whether customer data keys are customer-managed (CMKs) or Redwood-managed (service-managed). If CMKs, please share KMS provider and key rotation cadence.
- Will the jumpbox be under our IP allowlist? If so, we need a predictable egress IP range.

If you can upload a redacted SOC 2 summary to the shared drive I can get pre-approval from our InfoSec lead, which should speed the procurement timeline.

Thanks,
Anita Gomez
Information Security Manager | ACME Corporation
anita.gomez@acme.com
